structured.answer: I'd open a trading account at פסגות and buy "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)", the pair the page marks as "הזול". With 10,000 ₪ now and 500 ₪ a month for 10 years, the page says I end up with about 86,492 ₪ from 70,000 ₪ put in.

stuck.where: Inputs on screen 1 (סכום היום 10,000, הפקדה חודשית 500)
stuck.why: My own numbers are 30,000 and a few hundred a month, but I only had screenshots, so I went with the page's defaults. My final number isn't really mine.
Too many funds that look the same, with lots of coloured tags (צוברת, עסקת החלף, מס גם על שינוי המטבע). I just took the top one the page had marked.

stuck.where: Screen 5, the הראל מנוטרלת מט"ח row
stuck.why: "בין +2,212 ל- −23,766 ₪" in red scared me off it straight away.
Lots of lines and red minus numbers (−21.8%, −12.5%). This is where I'd close the page.
